name: hgv-player
description: HGV Player - real-time YouTube watch party platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c red,gray "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
scripts.build: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.test: npm run test -w shared && npm run test -w backend && npm run test -w frontend
